comparison.objective: Press a flanged bearing onto a robot-link shaft until seated; candidate commissions a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial bore-to-shaft alignment and force-controlled press fit past a spring ball versus tool insertion, unlocking, fine rotary tuning, relocking, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Bearing clicks past the detent and seats on the shoulder versus two energy-qualified stops within stroke and retention limits.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot hardware and force control, but industrial labels and generic force control do not create overlap; assembly insertion is meaningfully different from calibration. Record has no specs or force/damage tolerances.
